This encoding uses the target labels from the training data, potentially introducing information about the target into the feature set, leading to target leakage.

The preprocessing code applies target-rate encoding using the full training data to compute the segment rate for the test set, which can lead to leakage as it uses information from the entire training set, including the test set, to compute the mapping.
